notes: v1.2.9 hotfix for v1.2.8. The once-flow dropdown (used to pick Setup and Teardown attachments) was showing every saved flow as buu-flow instead of its actual filename. Caused by a fallback in saveFlow that stamped name=buu-flow on every save. Fixed by using filename as the source of truth. After installing v1.2.9 your existing once-flows will show by filename in the dropdown - no need to recreate them.
